summary_for_children: As-Sajdah means The Prostration. It reminds us that Allah created people from clay and gave us hearing, sight and hearts. It praises those who rise at night to pray and shows how water brings crops to barren land.
world_title: Night Rising and the Dry Land
environment_concept: A riverbank of clay (32:7), a village with lamps at night (32:16) and dry land receiving water (32:27).
architecture_and_scenery: Quiet clay houses under stars, a lamp-lit prayer space, and a dry plain with a river channel.

palette.lighting: Moonlight and small lamps, then dawn over a plain

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.

unique_world.visual_theme: Green hills with three fenced paddocks around a stone fold, oaks and a path from the south

primary_mechanic.text: Lead a small flock out of the fold and from paddock to paddock: where it grazes the grass goes down, and where it has left the grass grows back. Keep it fed through three days without any paddock eaten down to bare soil; if one is, the flock goes back to the fold and the day starts again (32:27). The growing is only watched.

secondary_activities: rising at night in fear and hope (32:15-16)
unique_world.narrative_structure: The sign, three grazing days, then two readings
world_assets: three fenced paddocks with grass tufts
a flock of the existing sheep
environment_behaviour: paddock ground and tufts fade from green to bare as the flock grazes and grow back after it leaves
the sheep walk between paddocks and graze
unique_world.learning_objective: Notice how land, rain and grazing animals depend on each other (32:27), and care for a flock

story_library.source: Owner's 'Quran Adventure — Children's Story Library' (2026-11-04), first-draft narration for ages about 7-12
story_library.title: The Wonders of Creation
story_library.children_narration: The Quran asks us to reflect on creation, human life, and our return to Allah. It reminds us that true believers are willing to listen, reflect, and worship with humility. Every breath and every opportunity to do good matters.

world_idea.title: The Layers of Creation
world_idea.description: Travel through symbolic environments representing the earth, sky, and the development of living things. Interactive exhibits teach observation and gratitude without visualizing divine actions.

story_library.checks: Every reference exists in the verified text (checked 2026-11-04). Narration is draft, written by the owner, not reviewed by a scholar.
